sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 860. Success value 100. 2x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 40 for 150 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Grief (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Burial Eclipse (decreases all stats by 40%, decreases physical and magic Ability Power by 100, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 50) to the enemy field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70
